units.source_text: 我确信的理由是这样的：今晚上课和老师相对而坐，是很不合我的性格的。

en.t: The reason I was convinced was this: sitting face to face with the teacher in class tonight did not suit my nature at all.

units.source_text: 不过，我自己感到这应该说是一种男性的勇气。

en.t: However, I myself felt that this ought to be called a kind of masculine courage.

units.source_text: 那么，老师就会相应地表现出男性的美德，打破伪善，在寺庙的所有人面前坦白自己的行径，尔后再责问我的卑劣行为。

en.t: Then the teacher, in response, would display the virtues of a man, break through his hypocrisy, confess his own conduct before everyone in the temple, and only afterward reproach me for my despicable behavior.
